# jsails CLI signature

The help `jsails <command> --help` prints for every built-in command, in the
order `jsails --help` lists them. Names, arguments, options and their
summaries are the CLI's public contract: review a change line by line.

## create

```text
jsails create - Scaffold a fresh JSails application

Usage:
  jsails create [options] <dir>

Arguments:
  <dir>    The directory to create

Options:
      --name <name>             The npm package name (default: derived from the directory)
      --jsails-dependency <spec>
                                The jsails dependency specifier (a file: path or a semver range)
      --package-dependency <name>=<spec>
                                Override one plugin dependency specifier (repeatable)
      --install                 Run npm install in the new project
      --no-git                  Skip git init
      --starter                 The static site starter (the default)
      --admin                   The server-rendered starter with the admin panel
      --blog                    The standalone blog CMS starter
      --saas                    The multi-tenant starter: admin, tenancy and flags
      --cli                     A CLI-only starter with no web surface
  -h, --help                    Show this help

The presets (--starter, --admin, --blog, --saas, --cli) exclude one another.
```

## console

```text
jsails console - Start an interactive REPL with the database and jobs runtime loaded

Usage:
  jsails console [options]

Options:
  -c, --config <path>          The database config module (default: jsails.database.js)
      --runtime-config <path>  The runtime config module (default: jsails.runtime.js)
  -h, --help                   Show this help

The REPL exposes db (the initialized data source), models (entity name to class),
config (the loaded config metadata) and jobs (the jobs runtime). A config module that
does not exist is skipped and the REPL still opens. Leave it with .exit or Ctrl+D.
```

## db:push

```text
jsails db:push - Diff the declared model schema against the live database and apply the plan

Usage:
  jsails db:push [options]

Options:
  -c, --config <path>        The database config module (default: jsails.database.js)
      --app-config <path>    The app config whose plugins declare schema (default: jsails.app.js)
      --dry-run              Print the plan without applying it
      --allow-destructive    Permit destructive changes
      --approve <digest>     Apply the deferred operation db:diff printed with this digest (repeatable)
      --approve-all          Apply every deferred operation (development and test only)
      --wait-lock <seconds>  How long to wait for another push's schema lock (default: 60)
      --json                 Print the plan or the push report as JSON
  -h, --help                 Show this help

A defineSchemaConfig() config takes --approve, --approve-all, --wait-lock and --json;
a JsailsDataSource config takes --dry-run, --allow-destructive and --app-config.
```

## convert

```text
jsails convert - Toggle a .jsails component between one file and a folder of files

Usage:
  jsails convert [options] <path>

Arguments:
  <path>    The component file or folder

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this help

A single file (pages/about.jsails) becomes the folder pages/about/ (about.jsails,
about.ts, about.css, about.scoped.css); a folder (pages/about, or its
pages/about/about.jsails) becomes the single file. The server module
about.server.ts moves with the component. A file becomes a folder only in a
project that syncs .jsails sidecars (.jsails/sfc in the working directory).
```

## credentials

```text
jsails credentials - Create, change, list, or rotate the sealed per-environment credentials

Usage:
  jsails credentials [options] <action> [<operand>]

Arguments:
  <action>     init, edit, set, unset, show, import or rotate
  [<operand>]  set/unset: the NAME; import: the dotenv file

Options:
      --env <name>   The environment whose credentials to change (default: the resolved one)
      --from <file>  init: seal this dotenv file
      --finish       rotate: retire the previous key
  -h, --help         Show this help

set reads the value from standard input, so it never appears in an argv. show prints
names, never values. rotate adds a new current key to the ring and re-seals the
document under it; the previous key stays until "rotate --finish", so servers still
running the old document keep working. When JSAILS_CREDENTIALS_KEY holds the ring,
copy the key file's keys into it (comma-separated) after each step.
Files: config/credentials/<env>.enc (sealed, committed) and
config/credentials/<env>.key (the key ring, git-ignored).
```

## plugins

```text
jsails plugins - List and check the JSails plugin packages the app depends on

Usage:
  jsails plugins [options] [<subcommand...>]

Arguments:
  [<subcommand...>]
                  list (the default) or check

Options:
      --json  Emit machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help  Show this help

list prints each plugin package with its provenance; check validates their manifests
against the framework version and exits 1 on a finding.

A plugin package is a direct or transitive npm dependency that self-identifies
through its package.json "jsails" field. Listing one does not run it: a plugin
runs when the app config lists it in plugins.use. The command reads manifests
only and never imports plugin code.
```

## mcp

```text
jsails mcp - Serve read-only introspection of this app to an AI agent (MCP over stdio)

Usage:
  jsails mcp [options]

Options:
  -c, --config <path>     The app config module (default: jsails.app.js)
      --db-config <path>  The database config module (default: jsails.database.js)
  -h, --help              Show this help

Point your agent or editor at "jsails mcp" as a stdio MCP server. Messages are
newline-delimited JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout; nothing else is written to stdout.
Output from the app's own modules (console.log included) goes to stderr.

Protocol: MCP 2026-07-28 (server/discover, tools/list, tools/call), and the 2025
revisions for clients that open with an initialize handshake. The server exits when
stdin closes, or on SIGINT or SIGTERM.

Tools (all read-only, idempotent, and local):
  jsails_describe        the app definition: routes, plugins, commands, schema
  jsails_inspect_routes  every page and API route with its parameters
  jsails_explain_route   which route serves a path (matched: false when none)
  jsails_schema          the declared entity schema, without a connection

The tools run the selected config modules' top-level code but never write to the
filesystem or open a database connection; a tool call cannot choose another module.
```

## agents:setup

```text
jsails agents:setup - Write .mcp.json, AGENTS.md and a JSails skill so an AI agent can drive this app

Usage:
  jsails agents:setup [options]

Options:
  -f, --force  Overwrite AGENTS.md and the skill (.mcp.json is always merged)
  -h, --help   Show this help

Writes .mcp.json (registers "jsails mcp" as the "jsails" MCP server, merged into an
existing file), AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/jsails/SKILL.md. Existing files are left
alone unless --force; never runs the app config or opens a connection.
```

## jamal

```text
jsails jamal - Run the project's @jsails/jamal (local services and deploys)

Usage:
  jsails jamal [arguments...]

Every argument goes to jamal, --help included; jamal decides each verb's environment.
```
